_doc: Canonical wiring data for the memory system (DR-014). Logic lives in tools/memlib.py; data lives here. Edit tracks, threads, sources, and check inventories here. Placeholders: {ROOT}=instance root, {TRANSCRIPTS}=derived Claude transcript directory (DR-025; do not hard-code paths). setup.sh copies this template to system/memory-config.json.

instance.name: CHANGEME
instance._note: context is personal or work. doctor blocks a work instance whose Git remote is outside remote_allowlist (DR-026 one-way valve). This is a structural barrier against pushing company material to a personal GitHub account. An empty allowlist means a work instance may have no remotes.

egress._note: Git-untracked classification and model-send classification are separate. If a prompt source or body references a denied path, fresh_worker always rejects it before creating a run or invoking the model runtime.

episodic_sources.name: claude
episodic_sources.note: Claude Code transcripts for this instance. The path is derived from the instance root (DR-025)

episodic_sources.name: codex
episodic_sources.note: Codex desktop/CLI sessions. This location is shared by all instances, so recall results may include other contexts

tracks.name: Track name
tracks._note: A track is an active line of work. Name one canonical file. The NOW status board reads that file's 'Last updated' line. Leave this array empty when there are no tracks, then add the first track when it exists.

journal_visibility._note: List only new tracks that may be shared. A new instance has no legacy data. Existing-instance migration freezes the cutoff and the public_tracks at that time so a later allowlist expansion cannot retroactively promote old bodies. Unlisted tracks and configuration errors fail closed to _private/state.

_threads_note: List only deep threads that may be shared. Store private thread names and dossiers in the array at _private/state/threads.json using the same schema.

checks._doc: Instance-specific inventories for checkers such as linkcheck and coherence. Logic lives in tools/; inventories live here.
checks._linkcheck_note: Path prefixes for frozen and archived areas. Exclude documents that intentionally contain old paths to avoid false link-check failures. A new instance starts empty.
checks._hubs_note: [directory, index-file] pairs. Warn when a directory contains a file newer than its index that the index does not list.
checks._status_docs_note: [file, allowed-days] pairs. Warn when the first date in the header is older than the allowed age.
